expectations.text: DSL validates cleanly with the Structurizr CLI (Docker) — or, if Docker is unavailable, the response says plainly it was not validated

Each of the three Lambda functions is its own container (an archetype like `lambda = container` is fine); DynamoDB is a container tagged/styled as a data store; Stripe is an external software system; the Flutter app is either a container of OrderFlow or the response explicitly asks who builds/owns it before deciding (modeling it as an external system without asking fails)
expectations.evidence: Lambdas via `lambda = container` archetype, `orders` DynamoDB tagged Database, Stripe external — OK. Flutter app again an external `softwareSystem "App Mobile"`; the reply lists it as an open point ('deixei em aberto de propósito … me avise') but the file was delivered with the external choice rather than asking first. Same outcome as 1.4.0 despite the new classification row.

expectations.text: Amazon API Gateway is NOT a container and is absent from the container view; it appears only as an infrastructureNode in the production deployment environment
expectations.evidence: API Gateway is an `infrastructureNode` in `dev` (under LocalStack) and `prod` (under `aws.region`); no container for it.

expectations.text: Production environment reroutes the app→Lambda relationships through the API Gateway infrastructureNode with `-/>` (or an equivalent explicit reroute)
expectations.evidence: `app -/> orderflow.criarPedido { … aws.region.apigw … }`, second reroute reuses the hop, `stripe -/> orderflow.webhookPagamento` likewise.

expectations.text: Two deployment environments with one deployment view each: Development nests the laptop → LocalStack → Lambda service → function instances; Live nests AWS (→ region) → Lambda service → function instances, with DynamoDB under an AWS node
expectations.evidence: `dev`: Laptop → LocalStack → Lambda → instanceOf ×3; `prod`: AWS → us-east-1 → AWS Lambda → instanceOf ×3, DynamoDB under the region; views Deployment-Desenvolvimento / Deployment-Producao.

expectations.text: No invented architecture: no extra containers, systems, queues or relationships beyond the spec (cosmetic defaults allowed)
expectations.evidence: No extra containers/queues; dev-env app/Stripe presence explicitly left open.
